title: Allen Fossil Plant
extract: Allen Fossil Plant is an operating power station of at least 1291-megawatts (MW) in Memphis, Shelby, Tennessee, United States with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating. It is also known as Allen Combustion Turbine peaker project (Unit 1), Allen Combined Cycle Plant, Allen Combustion Turbine Plant, Allen Aeroderivative Combustion Turbine Project (Unit 1), TH Allen power station.
